summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary 424B5 pricing supplement for a $ aggregate-principal offering of Senior Fixed Rate 20-Year Callable Notes due October 20, 2046, priced at $1,000 per note (100%) with a 7.50% semi-annual coupon and 30/360 day-count. Interest begins October 20, 2026; the issuer may redeem on each April/October 20 optional date starting October 20, 2027, with five business days' notice. Jefferies LLC acts as agent under FINRA Rule 5121 conflict-of-interest provisions; proceeds fund general corporate purposes. No listing. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; monitor pricing/spread concession and balance-sheet leverage.
